evidence: Rewrites the USDT functional test harness in test/functional/test_framework/usdt.py and updates five interface_usdt_*.py test suites.
rationale: Replacing BCC and eBPF with GDB eliminates a heavy external dependency and root privilege requirement for running tracepoint tests. Per the PR description, 'All five tests can run with GDB and binutils, without BCC or matching kernel headers,' substantially reducing contributor friction and removing hundreds of lines of complex embedded BPF test code.
